rule.roll_mod.1.1: Using, seeking or spreading cheats, mods or resource packs that give an advantage and are not part of the standard client or admin-approved mods is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.1.1: Exploiting bugs that give an advantage or benefit in gameplay or other use of the game client is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.2: Griefing claims (using game mechanics to interfere with someone else's claim) is strictly forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.3: Deceiving, or trying to deceive, the administration or game staff is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.4: Keeping or using resources obtained dishonestly (dupes, bugs, etc.).
rule.roll_mod.1.5: Disrupting the stability of the game server in any way is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.6: Mass giveaways of valuable resources (more than three people) without the administration's permission.
rule.roll_mod.1.6.1: Advertising or announcing a giveaway (even as a joke).
rule.roll_mod.1.6.2: Creating warps with free item services is forbidden, except public mob farms.
rule.roll_mod.1.7: Breaking the rules of events and contests.
rule.roll_mod.1.8: Selling or buying any in-game resources for real money is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.9: Creating more than five accounts per player is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.10: Transferring or selling your accounts is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.11: Any attempt to hack accounts is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.12: Inciting others to break the rules.
rule.roll_mod.1.13: Deception or misinformation that may harm other players.
rule.roll_mod.1.14: An administrator or moderator may temporarily ban an account (up to 30 days) or mute (up to 5 days) to investigate cases the rules do not cover.
rule.roll_mod.1.15: Using "Anti-AFK" programs or mechanics to avoid being kicked for inactivity is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.16: Using other players' personal data without their consent is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.1.18: Harmful actions against the administration or server staff (e.g. stream sniping).
rule.roll_mod.1.19: Any tampering with the launcher's code, decompiling it, using third-party clients to bypass the project's authorisation, or attempting to attack the server infrastructure is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.1: Using Russian in public game chats and Discord channels is strictly forbidden. The project's official languages are Ukrainian and English.
rule.roll_mod.2.2: Insults, humiliation, pornographic or provocative content are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.2.2: Insults aimed at the relatives of players or of the administration.
rule.roll_mod.2.3: Writing messages mostly in capital letters (Caps Lock) is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.4: Spamming chats with meaningless or repeated phrases (flood), abusing commands, duplicating messages across channels and mass flooding are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.5: Advertising third-party resources, projects or software without the administration's agreement (including private messages) is forbidden. Exception: links to personal pages in local game chats.
rule.roll_mod.2.6: Inciting or calling for breaking the server rules, or stirring up conflicts between players or with the administration, is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.7: Discussing moderators' actions in public chat, discrediting the project team, pestering staff without reason or provoking them is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.2.8: Warps or shops may be mentioned no more than once every 10 minutes.
rule.roll_mod.3.1: Whatever happens inside a claim is decided by its owners and members. A claim member taking items from that claim is not punished.
rule.roll_mod.3.2: Building or placing objects with offensive, provocative, pornographic or political content, swastikas, drug references or other inappropriate content is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.3.3: Do not spoil the world outside claims: chaotically destroying nature, leaving unfinished builds, spilling liquids, pointless pillars and the like.
rule.roll_mod.3.4: Blocking access to other players' claims or other worlds, or building traps that cannot be escaped, is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.3.5: Names of any objects (items, books, mobs, claims, etc.) must not contain adult or offensive content.
rule.roll_mod.3.6: Destroying chests, minecarts or shulker boxes with individual loot without good reason is forbidden. Exception: the chest is in your own region.
rule.roll_mod.3.7: Building or claiming right next to another player's claim without their consent, or deliberately surrounding someone's territory to block its expansion, is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.1: Nicknames with swearing, offensive, provocative, pornographic or advertising content, or drug references, are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.2: Prefixes with swearing, offensive, provocative, pornographic or advertising content, or drug references, are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.3: Skins and capes with adult content are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.4: Nicknames, prefixes or profile styling that mislead others into thinking you are project staff or a well-known media figure are forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.4.1: Registering a nickname similar to another player's in order to impersonate them is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.4.5: Logging in, or trying to log in, to other people's accounts is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.5.1: Killing players in a no-PvP zone, or from one, is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.5.2: Killing at respawn points (/home, /warp) within 10 seconds of a teleport, or blocking the exit, is forbidden, unless the teleported player started the fight.
rule.roll_mod.5.3: Staying in someone else's claim after the owner or a member has asked you to leave (at least twice) is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.5.4: If PvP is enabled in a claim, it must be clearly marked.
rule.roll_mod.5.5: Logging out during PvP to gain an advantage is not allowed.
rule.roll_mod.5.6: Pushing players into dangerous areas by any means is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.6.1: Setting a shop's public warp for players who are not members of the claim is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.6.2: Setting a price below the minimum set by the administration (if there is one) is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.6.3: PvP enabled or dangerous areas (traps) in a shop without a clear warning; a PvP zone must start at least 8 blocks from the respawn point.
rule.roll_mod.6.4: Breaking the terms of a deal between players that was confirmed in writing in chat.
rule.roll_mod.6.5: Giving out items, making deals or providing services obtained through virtual rewards (e.g. Prime status) is forbidden.
rule.roll_mod.6.6: Buying, selling or transferring a game account and/or resources for real-world value is forbidden.

tooltip.roll_mod.module.speed.desc.1: Drill: multiplies how fast blocks break; stacks with tier speed and the throttle.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speed.desc.2: Drill: energy per block grows by the same factor.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speed.desc.3: Saber: faster swings while the saber is switched on.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speed.desc.4: Replaces the old Attack Speed modules.
XP from mining or kills becomes energy: 1 XP = 100 EU.
Energy that doesn't fit goes to energy items in your inventory.
Whatever nothing can take is lost.
Without it, drill XP goes straight to you.
Warning: the tool can no longer be charged any other way.
Every 1% above 100% adds +10% energy per block.
Removing it drops the throttle back to 100%.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.reach.desc.1: Adds block reach while the drill is in your main hand.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.reach.desc.2: Area mining aims from the extended reach too.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.battery.desc.1: Raises the tool's maximum energy capacity.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.battery.desc.2: Adds no energy cost per block or hit.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.aoe.desc.1: Lets the drill mine a whole box instead of one block.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.aoe.desc.2: Set width, height and depth in the drill menu (V key).
tooltip.roll_mod.module.aoe.desc.3: Sizes are odd only (1, 3, 5...), up to this module's edge.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.aoe.desc.4: Every block in the box costs its own energy.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.eco.desc.1: Lowers energy use per block (drill) or per hit (saber).
Before mining, fluids in the mined box are sealed:
lava source -> obsidian, flowing lava -> cobblestone,
water is removed. The new crust is left standing.
Each sealed block costs one block's energy.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speak.desc.1: Every 10,000 blocks mined, the drill says a random line
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speak.desc.2: in chat to players within 32 blocks.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speak.desc.3: Gives back 5 complexity, freeing room for other modules.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.speak.desc.4: Can't be removed if that would put the drill over budget.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.damage.desc.1: Multiplies the saber's attack damage while it's on.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.damage.desc.2: Energy per hit grows by the same factor.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.attack_speed.des: Deprecated: Speed modules now give attack speed in sabers.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.sweep.desc.1: Every hit also strikes nearby hostile mobs.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.sweep.desc.2: Never hits players, pets or villagers.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.sweep.desc.3: Each extra mob hit costs half a hit's energy.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.xp_multiplier.de: Multiplies the XP dropped by saber kills.
Applied before the XP Reactor, so the two stack.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.drop_collector.d: Kill drops go straight into your inventory.
If the inventory is full, they drop at your feet.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.vampirism.desc.1: Every hit heals you for part of the damage dealt.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.beheading.desc.1: Chance to drop a head on kill: zombie, skeleton,
tooltip.roll_mod.module.beheading.desc.2: wither skeleton, creeper, piglin, ender dragon, players.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.irradiation.desc: Players: a radiation dose, reduced by radiation-resistant armour.
tooltip.roll_mod.module.meteorite.desc.1: Gives any saber the meteorite blade and its skins
tooltip.roll_mod.module.meteorite.desc.3: +20 flat attack damage, added after the Damage module.
tooltip.roll_mod.modular_saber.idle: Idle drain while on: %s per second
